title: 第785章 圣物第784章 自寻生路
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: “我自幼被尊为圣女，受万人敬仰，享受无尽资源供奉。”
“可谁又知，我不过是为巫神降临准备的一具纯净躯壳。”
“一旦巫神意志占据这具躯体。”
那双深邃如渊的眸子，让人根本猜不透他想做什么。
此刻是哑巴吃黄莲，有苦说不出。
他费尽心思绑回的圣女。
为此甚至不惜燃烧了几十年的寿元。
原本以为是险中求富贵，绑了个大功劳。
这圣女竟是自己送上门来的。
那他的功劳岂不是得大打折扣？
“不过，你凭什么觉得，孤不会杀你，甚至还要保你？”
“孤伐南荒，为的是踏平南荒，绝巫神道统。”
黎音迎着李行歌那极具压迫感的目光。
她不卑不亢道：“杀我，不过多一具枯骨。”
“留我，楚王殿下能以最快的速度，得到一个完整的南荒。”
“我乃巫神殿圣女，大祭司生前唯一指定的继任者。”
“大祭司坐化，我便是新的巫神殿大祭司。”
content_en:
Li Yin continued.
"I have been revered as a saint since I was a child, respected by thousands of people, and enjoy endless resources for worship."
"Everyone in the world envies me for being so high and mighty."
"But who knows, I am just a pure body prepared for the arrival of the Witch God."
"Once the Witch God's will takes over this body."
"My soul will be instantly wiped out."
"The soul and soul will be destroyed, and there will be no more Li Yin in the world."
Li Xingge looked at her quietly.
Those eyes as deep as the abyss made it impossible to guess what he wanted to do.
And Gu Hongzi.
At this moment, I am a mute eating yellow lotus, unable to express my suffering.
The saint he took great pains to kidnap back.
He even spent decades of his life for this.
I originally thought that I was seeking wealth in danger, but I got a lot of credit.
The result?
This saintess actually came to the door by herself.
Then wouldn’t his merit be greatly discounted?
Who should he talk to to reason with this?
After a while.
Li Xingge suddenly laughed.
He looked directly at Li Yin.
"What a holy lady from the Witch Temple."
"What a very smart woman."
Li Xingge stopped laughing.
His expression suddenly turned cold.
"But why do you think Gu won't kill you, and even wants to protect you?"
"The purpose of attacking the Southern Wilderness alone is to conquer the Southern Wilderness and eliminate the witch-god orthodoxy."
"Keep you."
"What's the use of being alone?"
Li Yin met Li Xingge's oppressive gaze.
There was no trace of timidity on his face.
She said neither humble nor arrogantly: "Killing me will only give you one more withered bone."
"Leave me alone, His Royal Highness the King of Chu can obtain a complete Southern Wilderness as quickly as possible."
"One."
"I am the Holy Maiden of the Witch Temple, the only successor designated by the high priest during his lifetime."
"The high priest has passed away, and I will be the new high priest of the Witch Temple."
